title: Member-Filed Replacement of a Lost or Stolen Prescription Supply
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit.** When a member reports a prescription supply lost or stolen, the replacement fill of that prescription is paid as a lost or stolen override, within the plan's per-drug limit and, for a controlled substance, only with the police report number the member gives.

### When the replacement days are fixed

The replacement days are fixed only after every counter rejection for prior authorization whose drug has an undecided request carries an emergency supply of that drug.

The replacement days are not fixed until every non-formulary refill rejection of a member inside the transition window carries a transition fill of that drug.

The replacement days are fixed only after every vacation override granted in the last thirty days carries a released vacation fill.

### Business effect

One run records a lost or stolen early refill override for the prescription, dated the day it is filed and carrying the police report number the member gives, and adds one paid replacement fill of that prescription to the member's pharmacy claims with the days supply and copay given. Afterwards the pharmacy can dispense the replacement, and the member's pharmacy requests and claims show the override and the replacement fill.

### How it is invoked

This is the member's own request. The agent unlocks the tool `request_replacement_fill_14de4074` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rx_coverage_id` | The reference number of the member's pharmacy coverage record, as the member services representative reads it from the pharmacy coverage lookup | Identifier, as shown by the lookup |
| `rx_number` | The prescription number printed on the label | Verbatim: copied character for character as the member reads it |
| `police_report_number` | The police report number the member gives for the loss or theft | Verbatim: copied character for character as the member states it |
| `days_supply` | The days of the drug in the replacement fill | A positive integer number of days |
| `member_copay` | The copay assessed on the replacement fill | USD, signed, with 2 decimal places; 0.00 where the plan sets no copay |

### Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of `rx_exception_id` (the reference number of the lost or stolen override), `rx_fill_id` (the reference number of the replacement fill claim), `rx_number`, `days_supply` (integer days), `member_copay` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `status` (the text "replaced", which confirms the override and the replacement were recorded).
